notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 variant-record Discriminant Enumerator rule: each supplied individual enumerator and each supplied range endpoint must be declared by the selected enumerated discriminant type after the complete module set merges. If the selected enumeration has no declared enumerators, the preflight retains incomplete DIF rather than inventing a closed member set. The paired range-semantics contract separately applies declaration-order expansion, cross-alternative overlap detection, and the HLAother complement model. The immutable Requirements Lab candidate exports broad clause-4 provenance; RL-049 records that limitation. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
